compiled_state.title: [brainstorm/ticket-cli]: brainstorm:complete tag write -> Planning Intelligence Log not found in ticket events
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** e40a1ab90efa9d4e85269bdc5140125eb8a29546
* **Plugin cache version observed:** 1.16.11 (source on main has subsequent corrections; bug reproduces against source as well — see below)
* **Repo:** /Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra-worktrees/worktree-20260511-110427 (worktree)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

The brainstorm skill's Phase 3 Step 3a calls:

```
.claude/scripts/dso preconditions-record.sh --ticket-id <id> --gate-name brainstorm_complete ...
.claude/scripts/dso ticket untag <id> scrutiny:pending
.claude/scripts/dso ticket tag <id> brainstorm:complete
```

After a successful brainstorm — approved epic spec, follow-on gate complete, sentinel written — these three commands should leave the epic in the durable `brainstorm:complete` state. The `brainstorm:complete` tag is the signal downstream skills (preplanning, sprint) consume to verify brainstorm has run.

#### Actual Behavior

In a real session (2026-05-11, epic 4911-c7ba reframed):

* `preconditions-record.sh` succeeded and emitted a PRECONDITIONS.json artifact.
* `ticket untag scrutiny:pending` succeeded (or no-op — the tag was present).
* `ticket tag brainstorm:complete` FAILED with:

```
Error: cannot add 'brainstorm:complete' tag: Planning Intelligence Log not found in ticket events.
Run /dso:brainstorm on this epic first to generate the Planning Intelligence Log.
```

The error message is also misleading: brainstorm just ran, all the way through Phase 3. The user has no way to interpret it except to re-run brainstorm, which would not (in this implementation) write the PIL either.

### Root cause (contract gap)

The `ticket tag brainstorm:complete` enforcement layer requires a Planning Intelligence Log (PIL) event on the ticket. Nothing in the brainstorm flow as executed actually writes a PIL event. The approval-gate doc (`phases/approval-gate.md`) references \"Record the planning-intelligence log entry (see \`epic-description-template.md\`)\" under option (a), but inspecting the executed flow (and the prose in `phases/epic-description-template.md` accessed via the cache) does not surface a concrete `emit-planning-intelligence-log.sh` (or equivalent) call.

The contract failure: the tag's precondition (PIL exists) is not satisfied by any step in brainstorm's actual write sequence. This affects every consumer of `/dso:brainstorm` whose epic does not happen to have a PIL event from some other source. The cache version skew is NOT the cause; the source on `main` calls the same `ticket tag brainstorm:complete` from Step 3a with the same precondition.

### 3. Action History

1. `/dso:brainstorm 4911-c7ba` — full Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3 executed, user-approved spec at gate.
2. Phase 3 Step 1 — `ticket edit` of description and title — succeeded.
3. Phase 3 Step 3a — `preconditions-record.sh` succeeded; `ticket tag brainstorm:complete` failed with PIL error.
4. Sentinel file written successfully (Step 3b).

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* Primary affected: `/dso:brainstorm` Phase 3 Step 3a.
* Downstream affected: `/dso:preplanning` precondition checks against the `brainstorm:complete` tag — any consumer of brainstorm cannot satisfy preplanning's gate.
* Workaround in this session: skipped the tag, relied on sentinel + description state as the durable artifacts.

### 6. Logs

```
$ .claude/scripts/dso preconditions-record.sh --ticket-id 4911-c7ba --gate-name brainstorm_complete ...
Preconditions recorded: 1778526556279-85e1ab58-f066-4751-8143-0d5bcd63cc68-PRECONDITIONS.json

$ .claude/scripts/dso ticket untag 4911-c7ba scrutiny:pending
(no error)

$ .claude/scripts/dso ticket tag 4911-c7ba brainstorm:complete
Error: cannot add 'brainstorm:complete' tag: Planning Intelligence Log not found in ticket events.
Run /dso:brainstorm on this epic first to generate the Planning Intelligence Log.
```

### Possible fix paths (analysis only; pick during fix-bug)

1. `/dso:brainstorm` Phase 2 Step 4 option (a) writes a PIL event explicitly before Phase 3 starts (e.g., `emit-planning-intelligence-log.sh --ticket-id <id> --triggers ... --scenario-survivors N --revision-cycles N`). This is the doc-referenced path; the script just needs to exist and be called.
2. `ticket tag brainstorm:complete` precondition is loosened to require either a PIL event OR a preconditions baseline event with `gate-name=brainstorm_complete` (which IS being written). This makes the existing preconditions-record write satisfy the tag, eliminating the PIL dependency.
3. Tag enforcement layer rewords the error: when sentinel + preconditions exist but PIL is missing, distinguish from the \"brainstorm never ran\" case, so consumers stop following misleading guidance.
